claims.claim: In one LLNL Spheral simulation of a nuclear device near a 160-metre asteroid, 98 percent of the material became fully damaged and 97 percent exceeded escape velocity.
claims.episode_span: In the longest case 98 percent of the material became fully damaged and 97 percent exceeded escape velocity.
claims.source_title: Simulations explore nuclear mitigation of asteroid threats
claims.supporting_quote: In the longest-running simulation, about 98% of the asteroid material became fully damaged, meaning its ability to remain intact had been severely compromised. The simulation also showed that roughly 97% was moving faster than the asteroid's escape velocity.
